tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every band; the body and html background.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Raised console surfaces: stat cells, the ASCII bar panel, photo slots.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: band tops, row dividers, the 1px gaps of stat grids, image borders. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Primary ink: headings, body text, bars, the block cursor, text glow. 11.3:1 on void.

tokens.name: phosphor-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: captions, row values, eyebrow labels, the prompt user@host. 5.1:1 on void, 4.8:1 on screen.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Links, the typed command after the prompt, focus rings, the coin-flip (chance) bar. 11.6:1 on void.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: One alarming figure per screen (false positives, a warning). 7.1:1 on void. Never a fill.
